verdict.rationale: Goodwin's Founders Workbench offers free legal tools: Document Driver for generating formation documents, plus capital and liquidation calculators. Background automation is a plausible ask for startup legal-tech tooling, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows recurring, scheduled or autonomous background automations; the tools are on-demand, and probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
